description: Tên hiển thị chính của quỹ
Phân loại quỹ — Classification Value (scheme: FMS_FUND_TYPE)
Tên viết tắt công ty quản lý quỹ
etl_logic: JOIN fund_management_company ON fund_management_company.fmc_id = investment_fund.fmc_id AND fund_management_company.src_stm_code = 'FMS_SECURITIES' → fund_management_company.fmc_short_nm
JOIN custodian_bank ON custodian_bank.custodian_bank_id = investment_fund.custodian_bank_id AND custodian_bank.src_stm_code = 'FMS_BANK_MONI' → custodian_bank.custodian_bank_full_nm

description: Số lượng thành viên ban đại diện đang hoạt động — literal 'ban đại diện' tạm dùng nhãn HLD, CHƯA xác minh mã FMS_JOB_TYPE vật lý (TBD, cùng gap FMS.STATUS đã ghi ở Nhóm 1)
etl_logic: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investment_fund_representative_board_member INNER JOIN cl_fms_position ON cl_fms_position.cl_fms_position_code = investment_fund_representative_board_member.job_title_code AND cl_fms_position.src_stm_code = 'FMS_JOBS' WHERE investment_fund_representative_board_member.investment_fund_id = investment_fund.investment_fund_id AND investment_fund_representative_board_member.active_status_flag = 1 AND cl_fms_position.job_tp_code = 'ban đại diện' AND investment_fund_representative_board_member.src_stm_code = 'FMS_REPRESENT')
source_attribute: Investment Fund Representative Board Member Id

description: Số lượng người điều hành quỹ — literal 'ban điều hành' tạm dùng nhãn HLD, CHƯA xác minh mã FMS_JOB_TYPE vật lý (TBD)
etl_logic: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fmc_employee_x_investment_fund_relationship INNER JOIN fmc_employee ON fmc_employee.fmc_employee_id = fmc_employee_x_investment_fund_relationship.fmc_employee_id AND fmc_employee.src_stm_code = 'FMS_TL_PROFILES' WHERE fmc_employee_x_investment_fund_relationship.investment_fund_id = investment_fund.investment_fund_id AND fmc_employee.job_tp_code = 'ban điều hành' AND fmc_employee_x_investment_fund_relationship.src_stm_code = 'FMS_FUND_TL_PRO')
source_entity: Fund Management Company Employee X Investment Fund Relationship
